metadata.title: States of Matter
metadata.subtitle: Solid, Liquid, and Gas
metadata.subject: Science
metadata.author: Antigravity AI
learning_outcomes: Identify the three states of matter

ai_context.learning_goal: Teach students how molecules behave in different states.
ai_context.tutor_hint: Use water/ice/steam as the perfect example.

content.text: Everything around you is made of matter! Matter exists in three main states: Solid (like ice), Liquid (like water), and Gas (like steam).

content.question: Which state of matter takes the shape of its container?
content.explanation: Liquids flow and take the shape of the cup or bowl you pour them into!
